overview_description.description: Pachama harnesses AI and satellite data to empower companies to confidently invest in nature. Using the latest technological advances, Pachama delivers continuous insight into how forests sequester carbon, protect wildlife and benefit local communities. These insights enable leading companies to find the world’s best projects and track their impact over time while also helping land stewards earn an income with tools to develop carbon projects and secure funds.

about_short_description.short_description: Pachama harnesses AI and satellite data to empower companies to confidently invest in nature.

product.name: Pachama Platform
product.description: An integrated insights platform that streamlines the carbon investment process by enabling users to source, assess, and track nature-based carbon projects.

product.name: Diligence
product.description: A service providing rapid, data-driven reports and expert analysis to assess the quality and risk of carbon projects in days rather than months.

product.name: Source
product.description: A tool to collect standardized data and efficiently identify suitable nature-based carbon projects for investment or partnership.

product.name: Track
product.description: A monitoring service that provides real-time insights into forest carbon projects, including forest cover, wildlife activity, and fund allocation.

product.name: Ask Gaia
product.description: An AI-powered virtual assistant that provides users with information and guidance related to Pachama’s products and carbon market insights.

product.name: Pachama Originals
product.description: Nature-based carbon offset projects developed and managed by Pachama, featuring remote sensing and AI technology for carbon accounting and project monitoring.
